description: Synthetic telemetry dataset modeling player interactions across novice, intermediate, and expert cohorts.

features.name: player_id
features.description: Unique identifier for player session (e.g. P_0001)

features.name: time_per_room
features.description: Average duration spent in each unique room before transitioning.

features.name: hint_requests
features.description: Total number of explicit deductive hints requested during the escape run.

features.name: invalid_actions
features.description: Number of invalid actions, unachievable moves, or incorrect puzzle guesses.

features.name: backtrack_rate
features.description: Ratio of re-visited rooms to total room transitions.

features.name: search_efficiency
features.description: Theoretical optimal steps divided by actual actions taken (11 / Actions).

features.name: csp_attempts
features.description: Number of attempts required to solve combinatorial cipher locks.
